CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_journal_entry_trade_ownership()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM journal_entries je
    WHERE je.id = NEW.journal_entry_id
      AND je.user_id = NEW.user_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      MESSAGE = 'Journal entry link ownership is inconsistent.',

AS $function$
